description: Create a blocking dependency between tasks. Provide `depends_on` to make this task wait on another (this is blocked until that finishes), or `dependency_of` to make this task block another. Exactly one is required. Returns a confirmation.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when the task ids are custom task IDs instead of native ClickUp IDs. Requires `team_id`.

dependency_of.description: ID of the task that depends on THIS task (that task is blocked until this one completes).

depends_on.description: ID of the task that THIS task waits for (this task is blocked until that one completes).

task_id.description: ID of the task the dependency is anchored on.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: add_task_dependency
